title: Spec 014 Control Plane Approval Candidate Uniqueness

phases.objective: Reject multiple simultaneously active approval candidates for a required authorization slot instead of selecting one by ordering.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A single valid candidate is accepted, while multiple active candidates produce a slot-specific ambiguity blocker and no accepted approval.
steps: Start a clean Node runtime and build one secret-free approval set bound to the exact plan, candidate set, authority context, revisions, and impact set.
Resolve a required slot with one candidate, two active candidates, and one active plus one invalidated candidate.
Read back the immutable decision, blockers, and accepted approvals from the completed process.
assertions: Exactly one active approved candidate is accepted.
Multiple active approved candidates are rejected with STORAGE_APPROVAL_SLOT_AMBIGUOUS for the exact slot.
No candidate is accepted when the slot is ambiguous.
Invalidated candidates do not create ambiguity.

phases.objective: The hardening changes an in-process authorization decision and introduces no independent operational surface.
Ambiguity rejection is deterministic and has no retry or recovery state.
No live provider or non-production runtime target is introduced.
The change grants no dispatch, deployment, or Production authority.
